body_text:
Invariance of dimension. Any two bases of a vector space have the
same cardinality. This cardinal is the dimension $\dim_F V$. In
particular, if $V$ is spanned by $n$ vectors, every linearly
independent subset has at most $n$ elements and every basis has
exactly $\dim_F V\leq n$ elements.
